summary: Expanded the existing guarded member manual runner to retain independent create true/false, update true/false, add, remove and list observations on five disposable owned tabs and two groups. Source preparation only; no new native product pass or defect/inventory transition.
implementation: Each branch has its own report.branches key; completed earlier observations remain retained after a later failure.

Each operation invokes tab_groups through trusted side-panel input, queries actual Chrome tabs/tabGroups APIs, invokes get_tab_groups through the manual runner, and compares exact group identity, title/color/collapsed, membership, window and complete canonical list.
Canonical action=list is also compared against Chrome separately from get_tab_groups; no helper success response alone constitutes a pass.
Five owned same-window tabs begin ungrouped. Baseline comparisons enforce unchanged non-owned tabs/groups in every window and preserve the untouched true-create group.
Tool detail remounts and an empty output is required before each run, preventing prior tool output from satisfying a new branch.

All observed created groups are registered before subsequent readbacks. Cleanup ungroups/removes owned tabs only, checks every recorded owned group is absent, and compares final non-owned state against baseline.

Original true-create proof and first-failure stage/code remain retained. Allowlisted codes now recognize the first line of real Node AssertionError messages; appended actual values never enter the report.
